first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A gun-carrying person who continuously moves in the foreground, with short brown hair, wearing a dark blue-gray top and brown trousers, with a brown shoulder strap across the back.

entities.name: shop stall with a red roller shutter
entities.identification: The partially visible shop stall at the right edge of the opening frame, featuring a red panel, light-colored frame strips, and a partially visible gray roller shutter.

entities.name: wet flagstone passageway
entities.identification: The gray-brown paved passageway in front of the steps and to the image-right of the market hall, with irregular dark patches and localized reflections on its surface.

entities.name: group of people lying in front of the steps
entities.identification: Uses the shared set ID, referring to the people lying beside the wooden-slat partition and near the blue-and-white steps.

entities.name: blue-and-white steps
entities.identification: The wide, multilevel steps connecting the lower passageway to the market platform, with small alternating blue and white square tiles arranged on the risers.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: The long gun held by Person A, with a dark gun body, a yellow-brown front section, and a clearly visible hanging sling at the rear.

entities.name: wooden-slat partition
entities.identification: The tall partition on the image-left in the opening frame, composed of yellow-brown horizontal slats, darker vertical framing, and open gaps between the slats.

entities.name: raised market hall
entities.identification: The open market area above the blue-and-white steps, where light-colored square columns, dark counters, and goods are visible.

entities.name: market container
entities.identification: A set entity including the blue-green bucket at the lower left, the yellow bucket in front of the counter, and the blue-green container on the image-right of the upper passageway.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The large dark vehicle approaching from the distant passageway on the image-right of the market hall, with its broad, thick front gradually emerging from behind the distant yellow-green wooden rack.

entities.name: distant yellow-green wooden rack
entities.identification: The yellow-green strip-like frame in the distance on the image-right of the market hall, which gradually tilts and comes apart as Vehicle A advances.

entities.name: distant collision smoke and dust
entities.identification: The gray cloud appearing near Vehicle A and the distant yellow-green wooden rack.
